wk_assemble_L.notes: mallet stroke: support accepts f0-3.5 (overshoot), heel peels f4-5.5, slow heavy draw to f12 (knee cocked high, toe up = mallet up/back, body counter-pitches back and rises 1 cm), 2 f hang, 2.8 f accelerating strike (ankle spacing ~13/38/49 %, foot arcs forward then down, body pitch lunges with the largest step into contact), contact at 0.56, 3 cm rebound + hold, exponential ease-out (~60 % back by f23), heel plants f26, then the weight returns

wk_assemble_R.notes: mallet stroke: support accepts f0-3.5 (overshoot), heel peels f4-5.5, slow heavy draw to f12 (knee cocked high, toe up = mallet up/back, body counter-pitches back and rises 1 cm), 2 f hang, 2.8 f accelerating strike (ankle spacing ~13/38/49 %, foot arcs forward then down, body pitch lunges with the largest step into contact), contact at 0.56, 3 cm rebound + hold, exponential ease-out (~60 % back by f23), heel plants f26, then the weight returns

wk_brace_L.notes: brace (team load): weight accepted over 5 f, the foot rises to set its sole upright against the load at hip height (thigh near horizontal), the body sits back into a low strong stance, sustained hold kept alive by load pulses and effort tremor, re-press accent at 0.56 (foot drives 1.5 cm, body pushes back), release, heel plants f37, weight returns

wk_brace_R.notes: brace (team load): weight accepted over 5 f, the foot rises to set its sole upright against the load at hip height (thigh near horizontal), the body sits back into a low strong stance, sustained hold kept alive by load pulses and effort tremor, re-press accent at 0.56 (foot drives 1.5 cm, body pushes back), release, heel plants f37, weight returns

wk_carry.notes: loaded grounded jog 20 f (no flight), level steady body, deeper knees, wider track; L contact 0.0, R 0.5

wk_cheer.notes: completion cheer: quick dip, springy ballistic hop (~12 cm) with a real knee tuck (feet 13-16 cm up relative to the body, R a frame later and 3 cm higher), face up and a roll wiggle in the air, L lands a half frame before R, absorb, overshoot settle

wk_dance_a.notes: phrase A: TA-DA jump-out hit (b1: wide asymmetric feet, knees out, roll 8), groove with a heel pop (b2), side-step R then L travelling 0.16 m with rolls into the steps (b3-4), forward kick hit 45 deg with pointed toe, weight on the L leg (b5), knee-pop groove (b6), wind-up and a two-hop 360 spin (slow-fast-slow) landing on the 8th grid (7-and = f97.5, beat 8 = f105) into a ta-da hold and a settle

wk_dance_b.notes: phrase B: alternating heel taps on the 8ths with yaw/roll wiggles and 4.5 cm groove dips (b1-4), hop and hop (b5, b6: ballistic, feet tucked 9-12 cm above the body's lift, alternating which foot tucks higher), big gathered HOP with a 15 cm tuck (b7), pose hit on b8 with the weight on L and the R toe pointed out to the side, settle

wk_dance_c.notes: phrase C: heel-toe taps with body counter-rolls (b1-2), double knee pops with the knees snapping out and alternating heel pops (b3), body wave (b4), FLAMINGO knee-up hit on the L leg with a balance wobble (b5), quick knee swap (b6), ballistic side hops R then L with tucks (b7), asymmetric ta-da (b8) and step back in

wk_danger.notes: wary crouch on the balls of the feet, staggered stance; two DIFFERENT looks per loop (a 2 f snap right with overshoot and a short settle, then a slower 4-5 f smaller look left with a longer settle), ready bounces, a one-foot shuffle (weight onto R, the L heel lifts and re-grips), fear tremor

wk_greet.notes: greeting: 'oh!' rise onto the toes, weight onto L and a small R adjust step back (feet end offset 7 cm, never twin posts), dip wind-up, bow-hop (~5 cm, ballistic) with a 12 deg nod at the apex and the R foot tucked higher, landing absorb, happy glow: weight on L with a 6-7 deg side-tilt, free R heel pops on the tiny bounce, eased release, R steps back to the stance

wk_idle.notes: alert idle: irregular breaths, one weight shift each way with overshoot, glances, a curiosity lean, an unweighted heel-lift fidget; feet planted, never symmetric

wk_inspect_L.notes: curious probe: eyes/body orient, weight onto the support (f0-5), heel peel, lift with the toe leading, strong slow-in approach, light toe touch at 0.56, two rubs, nod + puzzled head tilt while the foot withdraws, heel plants f33.5, weight returns

wk_inspect_R.notes: curious probe: eyes/body orient, weight onto the support (f0-5), heel peel, lift with the toe leading, strong slow-in approach, light toe touch at 0.56, two rubs, nod + puzzled head tilt while the foot withdraws, heel plants f33.5, weight returns

wk_interrupted_L.notes: startle/interrupt: 2 f flinch (lean back, dip), work foot snaps up and replants under the hip, absorb, recover with a small forward overshoot, settle

wk_interrupted_R.notes: startle/interrupt: 2 f flinch (lean back, dip), work foot snaps up and replants under the hip, absorb, recover with a small forward overshoot, settle

wk_maintenance_L.notes: service ratchet: weight onto the support, foot sets on the fitting, quick twist + reset, harder twist with body counter-yaw clicking at 0.56, little shake, listen tilt (weight still held), heel plants f28.5, weight returns

wk_maintenance_R.notes: service ratchet: weight onto the support, foot sets on the fitting, quick twist + reset, harder twist with body counter-yaw clicking at 0.56, little shake, listen tilt (weight still held), heel plants f28.5, weight returns

wk_operate_L.notes: station duty: weight accepted over 5 f, foot hovers onto the pedal, small gather (body rises), decisive press bottoming at 0.56 with a body bounce, a shorter second pump, safe lift-off, heel plants f31, weight returns

wk_operate_R.notes: station duty: weight accepted over 5 f, foot hovers onto the pedal, small gather (body rises), decisive press bottoming at 0.56 with a body bounce, a shorter second pump, safe lift-off, heel plants f31, weight returns

wk_pickup_L.notes: small-part pickup: weight accepted over 5 f, lean in, open toe reaches down, grips at 0.56, lifts the part, flicks it up toward the head (face tracks up), foot comes down while the body dips to catch it on the head, heel plants f32, weight returns

wk_pickup_R.notes: small-part pickup: weight accepted over 5 f, lean in, open toe reaches down, grips at 0.56, lifts the part, flicks it up toward the head (face tracks up), foot comes down while the body dips to catch it on the head, heel plants f32, weight returns

wk_place_L.notes: place/install: weight to support, lower 7 cm and tip the head cargo toward the socket while the work foot steadies the part, seat at 0.56, relief pop (rises faster than it lowered) with the weight still held, heel plants f28, weight returns

wk_place_R.notes: place/install: weight to support, lower 7 cm and tip the head cargo toward the socket while the work foot steadies the part, seat at 0.56, relief pop (rises faster than it lowered) with the weight still held, heel plants f28, weight returns

wk_pull_L.notes: pull: weight accepted over 5 f, toe hooks the object ahead, body sits back, trembling draw, release at 0.56 snaps the foot back and the body lurches back, recover, heel plants f37, weight returns

wk_pull_R.notes: pull: weight accepted over 5 f, toe hooks the object ahead, body sits back, trembling draw, release at 0.56 snaps the foot back and the body lurches back, recover, heel plants f37, weight returns

wk_push_L.notes: push: weight accepted over 5 f, low vertical-sole contact, deep support knee, body drives forward with tremor, shove at 0.56 (foot extends 8 cm, body lurches forward), follow-through, release, heel plants f37, weight returns

wk_push_R.notes: push: weight accepted over 5 f, low vertical-sole contact, deep support knee, body drives forward with tremor, shove at 0.56 (foot extends 8 cm, body lurches forward), follow-through, release, heel plants f37, weight returns

wk_repair_L.notes: craftsman taps: still body (<0.5 deg f6-18), choked mallet feints 6 cm then 3.5 cm stopping 1 cm short, 11 cm draw, 2.9 f tap at 0.56, hold, 3 cm check lift, satisfied nod, heel plants f28.5, weight returns

wk_repair_R.notes: craftsman taps: still body (<0.5 deg f6-18), choked mallet feints 6 cm then 3.5 cm stopping 1 cm short, 11 cm draw, 2.9 f tap at 0.56, hold, 3 cm check lift, satisfied nod, heel plants f28.5, weight returns

wk_run.notes: job run 16 f: 5.4 f stance + 2.6 f flight per step, knee drive, trailing foot tucks high; L contact 0.0, R 0.5

wk_sit_down.notes: supported lower into the V-sit: glance down, weight onto R and a wide forward L step, weight onto L and the R step (toes out), the body travels forward over the feet and sumo-squats (COM over the soles, counter-pitch +14 deg, knees over the toes), then rocks back: the unweighting heels skid forward (authored slide f25-32) as the bottom lands at <= 2 cm/f (one continuous descent, <= 1 g down), 1 cm settle bump, the feet lift-and-place into the V (L then R), lean back face up; root Z carries the full seat descent

wk_sit_idle.notes: attentive V-sit: body pitched back, head forward/up, slow alternating 2-4 cm foot lifts with uneven gaps, toe wiggles, breathing, unhurried attention turns

wk_sit_up.notes: supported rise: eyes snap (head lifts), feet pulled back wide beside the body (two placements, toes out, knees up and out), a small rock back, then the body throws itself forward rolling onto its front-bottom edge between the legs (pitch +31 deg) so the bottom lifts with the COM arriving over the soles; push up forward-first then up with an ease-out; weight onto R and the L closing step during the last of the rise, weight onto L and the R closing step after L has planted, dip and settle; root advances ~0.30 m over the feet

wk_step_L.notes: reposition step: weight onto support (f0-3), heel peel, work foot swings forward 0.24 m with 8 cm clearance, heel lands at 0.56 and rolls flat, then the weight transfers over the new base (root advances 0.12 m)

wk_step_R.notes: reposition step: weight onto support (f0-3), heel peel, work foot swings forward 0.24 m with 8 cm clearance, heel lands at 0.56 and rolls flat, then the weight transfers over the new base (root advances 0.12 m)

wk_swim.notes: dog-paddle: body pitched back 20 deg (eyes above the waterline), alternating compact 15 f leg strokes under the chest (5 f power, 10 f recovery) in the body frame, a 2.5 cm forward surge + bob after every power stroke, roll in sync

wk_tool_change_L.notes: tool fetch/fit: weight accepted over 5 f, open toe reaches the handle with slow-in, snaps closed at 0.56, pulls the tool up/back (toe up = tool upright) with a counter-lean for the 5 kg mallet, sets the foot down (heel f31) still gripping; ends in the neutral stance with the toe still curled -24 deg round the handle (held-tool state)

wk_tool_change_R.notes: tool fetch/fit: weight accepted over 5 f, open toe reaches the handle with slow-in, snaps closed at 0.56, pulls the tool up/back (toe up = tool upright) with a counter-lean for the 5 kg mallet, sets the foot down (heel f31) still gripping; ends in the neutral stance with the toe still curled -24 deg round the handle (held-tool state)

wk_unbend_L.notes: sustained diagonal sole push: weight accepted over 5 f, sole settles low and far on the joint, brace, slow-in push along the diagonal with 7.5 Hz tremor (work knee extends ~65 -> ~35 deg), give at 0.56 (foot and body lurch 3-4 cm), support absorbs, exhale, heel plants f31, weight returns.  Silhouette: one long diagonal support foot -> body -> push leg

wk_unbend_R.notes: sustained diagonal sole push: weight accepted over 5 f, sole settles low and far on the joint, brace, slow-in push along the diagonal with 7.5 Hz tremor (work knee extends ~65 -> ~35 deg), give at 0.56 (foot and body lurch 3-4 cm), support absorbs, exhale, heel plants f31, weight returns.  Silhouette: one long diagonal support foot -> body -> push leg

wk_walkcycle.notes: springy bent-knee walk; heel strike -> flat -> toe roll; L contact at 0.0, R at 0.5; subtle root (gait owns bob/lean)
